Lessons.Title: Equal Groups of Non-Unit Fractions
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will apply understandings from previous lessons to multiply a non-unit fraction by a whole number.
Key idea: Whole-number multiples of non-unit fractions combine the numerators of equal groups while retaining the fractional whole.
How to reason: Calculate n × (a/b)=(n×a)/b and, when useful, rewrite as a mixed number.
Source-inspired opening: Warm-up: Notice and Wonder: Thirds (10 minutes). Use the teacher-provided mathematical representations and explain how different valid answers arise.

Activity 1: Jars of Jam (15 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as Elena fills 5 small jars with homemade jams to share with her friends. Each jar can fit, \(\frac{3}{4}\), If you have time: Elena still has some jam left. She takes 2 large jars and puts, \(\frac{5}{4}\). First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.

Activity 2: How Do We Multiply? (20 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as \(\frac{2}{5}\), \(4 \times \frac{2}{5}\), \(\frac{5}{8}\), \(3 \times \frac{5}{8}\). First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.
Original source Cool-down is access-restricted/unverified; Edulytics substitutes goal-aligned independently authored teacher-reviewed exit prompt.
Edulytics worked model: Five jars each hold 3/4 cup. Find the total.. Explain every transformation and check using equal wholes/units.
